newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas prices ease ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas prices ease ahead of weekend.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices were slightly weaker Friday, pressured by a return of normal to above-normal temperatures, sources said.
At the AECO storage hub, prices slipped by about five cents to the C$2.00-2.05 per gigajoule (GJ) range as seasonable temperatures were forecast to continue in Alberta through the weekend.
In Calgary, temperatures were expected to climb to about three to four degrees Celsius this weekend.
As a result of the milder weather, storage withdrawals dropped by about 375 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd), one Calgary-based trader said.
At Sumas, Wash., the western Canadian export point, prices for the weekend were mostly steady in the low-$2 per million British thermal units (mmBtu) area.
For next Tuesday's delivery, a deal was reported done at $2.15 per mmBtu at Sumas.
At Niagara, the eastern Canadian export point, prices drifted about three to five cents lower to the $3.10-3.15 per mmBtu range in light trade.
